caption: The drawing depicts a single pottery jug with a rounded body and a narrow, slightly wavy rim. The jug is beige-brown with subtle gradients, giving it a realistic three-dimensional appearance. There is a single handle on the right side of the jug. On the upper part of the jug, near the shoulder, is an inscription in uppercase letters that reads “WEST TROY, NY POTTERY” followed by a stylized number “6.” Below the inscription, towards the lower left, there is a blue painted decoration of a bird, facing right, perched on a curved branch with stylized leaves or tendrils. The drawing is signed in the lower left corner with the name “John Tarantino.” The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or details present.
title: Pitcher
